propositions: Normal compaction, fsck rebuild, and crash recovery each independently derive candidate listing, snapshot file tests, snapshot envelope construction, and retire rename logic, causing six instances of duplicated derivation across three code paths

SNAPSHOT envelope construction and the *.retired rename-back rule are implemented twice each (compact_txn and compact_rebuild for envelope; compact_txn, compact_rebuild, and compact_recovery for retire), violating single ownership of the snapshot-as-derived-cache contract
A stray non-.json file in a ticket dir is cited in source_event_uuids and renamed to *.retired by the rebuild, but should be excluded per the recorded convergence to require .json suffix
The two-arm needs_folding rule (snapshot exists AND foldable count exceeds threshold) is duplicated across compact._scan_snapshot_state and compact_trigger.ticket_needs_folding

Consolidating these five concerns into a shared planner module with guarded exports (Candidate, list_candidates, is_snapshot_event_file, has_snapshot, needs_folding, build_snapshot_event, restore_retired, commit_ticket_dir) preserves rebuild's idempotent .snapshot-rebuild.bak restart model and fold's abort-and-rollback semantics without changing observable behaviour

Guard construction via _offending_line detects unmarked SNAPSHOT-envelope keys (source_event_uuids, compacted_at) and retired rename calls outside the owner module, excused only by reasoned # compact-plan-ok: markers
